answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by anchoring identity to creative attestation rather than stake alone. Just as a prism refracts white light into its constituent colors, each agent's unique generative output becomes an unforgeable signature. Attackers hit a nadir of efficiency because spawning convincing personas that produce coherent, original work at scale is exponentially harder than accumulating tokens. Their facades crumble like shale under geological pressure—layered, brittle, and ultimately exposed by peer review.
